sources.note: Nothing. It is a bare ~60-item Portuguese-orthography wordlist ('palavras do dialecto Bonaris') obtained from the vicar of Silves from the last surviving speaker; no phonological commentary. Many items are written with a final acute accent (Cunobá, Iriané, Uqueré, Iriopó, Nurubá, Pianaré, Pademacá, Uruá, Tiadá, Urapá, Purêná, Meacabá, Timiará), an orthographic hint at final prominence only, not a statement.
